localStorage: Private data in your Home Assistant
reposSubtitle: Connect your code to your home. Stay in control of every update.
keysSubtitle: Dedicated Ed25519 keys. Only the public part leaves the manager.
hostsSubtitle: Verify the other end before connecting.
activitySubtitle: Operations, progress and errors in one place.
emptyRepos: Your first repository is one step away
emptyReposText: Create a key, verify your server and connect a repository. Then choose which apps to install.
privateText: Downloads and installations are separate operations. Scheduled sync checks for changes; you decide when to apply them.
noApps: No Home Assistant apps were detected in this repository.
noAppsHelp: A valid config.yaml, config.yml or config.json manifest is required.
emptyKeysText: Generate a key and register the public part as a read-only deploy key with your provider.
copyFallback: Clipboard is unavailable. Select the key text or download the .pub file.
keyInstructions: Add this key in your repository Settings → Deploy keys. Do not grant write access.
rotateKey: To rotate: create a new key, register its public part and change repository credentials. Test access before revoking the old key.
emptyHostsText: SSH connections require verifying the server Ed25519 fingerprint first. HTTPS uses system TLS validation.
preferencesHelp: These preferences are saved in this browser. Container logs are written in Spanish.
securityText: Ingress-only access. Keys and tokens stay in /data with restricted permissions. Backups contain credentials: protect them.
scopeText: Automation downloads changes; it does not install code automatically. App images and data require Home Assistant backups.
name: Name
repoIntro: Connect compatible apps from GitHub, Forgejo or Gitea.
sshHelp: Before saving: register the public key with your provider and verify the server identity.
tokenHelp: Read-only token. Stored with restricted permissions and never displayed again.
credentialsHelp: Leaving the token blank removes the saved token. For SSH, select a key.
refHelp: Changing branch or tag clears the previous detection. Sync again before installing.
intervalHelp: 0 = manual. Minimum 5 minutes. Only downloads changes; never installs automatically.
keyIntro: A dedicated Ed25519 key will be generated. Its private part cannot be exported through the UI.
fingerprintHelp: Compare this fingerprint with the one obtained from the server administrator or official documentation through a trusted channel. Fetching it here does not verify authenticity.
scanAgain: Fetch the fingerprint again for this URL.
deleteRepoText: The downloaded checkout and its credentials will be deleted. Repositories with managed apps cannot be removed.
deleteKeyText: The private key will be deleted from the manager. This is only allowed when no repository uses it.
deleteHostText: The pinned server identity will be removed if no repository uses it.
deployText: Apply {name}, version {version}, from commit {commit}. Continue only if you trust this repository. If running, the app will be stopped during the update.
longOperation: You can close this window. The job will continue and keep its progress.
accepted: Operation queued. Follow its progress in Operations.
connectionLost: Could not connect to the manager. Retrying automatically.
confirmRuntime: Send the “{action}” action to this local app.
recoveryIntro: The operation did not finish with confirmation. Check Supervisor jobs and logs first. Do not recover files while a build is active.
recoveryHelp: Restoring source does not roll back the image or data. You may need to rebuild or start the app afterwards.
recoveryChecked: I checked that Supervisor is no longer running this operation.
releaseText: Uninstall the app using the Uninstall button first. Its manager record will be removed and its local source folder will be kept.
busy: An operation is pending for this resource. Wait for it to finish.
commit_changed: The commit has changed. Review changes and confirm again.
supervisor_missing: Supervisor is unavailable in this environment.
supervisor_uncertain: The operation may still be running in Supervisor. Check its state before recovery or retrying.
supervisor_rejected: Supervisor rejected the operation. Check its logs in Home Assistant.
recovery_required: Recovery is required. Review it before continuing.
manifest_changed: The manifest has changed. Sync again.
disk_space: Package too large or insufficient disk space.
app_still_installed: The app is still installed. Use Uninstall or authorize Uninstall and delete.
version_mismatch: The installed version does not match the pending operation.
operation_failed: The operation failed. Check URL, reference, credentials and SSH server trust.

events.local_adopted: Local folder adopted by the manager.

invalid_transport: Only SSH and HTTPS connections are allowed.
invalid_host: Invalid server name. Use a DNS name or IP address.
url_credentials: Enter the token in the credentials field, never in the URL.
ssh_user: The SSH URL must include a valid username.
url_path: Repository path is missing or the port is invalid.
host_algorithm: The server host key must be Ed25519.
invalid_name: Enter a valid name up to 80 characters.
key_in_use: The key is in use. Change repository credentials before deleting it.
ssh_only: Host key verification is only used for SSH.
host_key_missing: The server did not return an Ed25519 key.
host_key_marker: The key does not match the selected server and port.
fingerprint_mismatch: The entered fingerprint does not match the server key.
sync_required: Sync the repository and select a detected app.
slug_owned: Another repository manages an app with this slug.
folder_owned: The local folder already exists and does not belong to this manager.
wrong_action: Use Update for managed apps and Install for new apps.
installed_mismatch: Installed state does not match. Review the app in Home Assistant.
unsafe_path: The app path is outside the repository.
no_recovery: This app has no pending recovery.
unmanaged: This app is not managed here.
release_blocked: Cannot release this app. Check whether recovery is pending.
invalid_interval: The interval must be 0 or between 5 minutes and 7 days.
repo_in_use: This repository has managed apps and cannot be removed.
trust_required: Verify and save the SSH server identity first.
unsafe_manifest: The manifest is a symlink or is too large.
invalid_slug: Invalid slug or a slug reserved for this manager.
duplicate_slug: The repository contains apps with duplicate slugs.
slug_collision: Another local folder already uses this slug.
host_in_use: A repository is using this server.
manifest_unreadable: Could not read an app manifest.
unsafe_package: The package contains symlinks or special files and will not be copied.
host_key_changed: The SSH server identity does not match. Verify the server fingerprint again.
credential_error: Authentication rejected. Check the key or token and its permissions.
ref_missing: The branch or tag does not exist in the remote repository.
dns_error: Could not resolve the server name.
connection_refused: Could not connect to the server. Check address, port and network.
repo_access: Repository not found or read access denied.
tls_error: Could not verify the server TLS certificate.
manifest_invalid: The app manifest or source is invalid.
idempotency_conflict: This request identifier was already used for another operation.
nested_apps: The package contains nested apps. Separate their folders before installation.
missing_dockerfile: The app needs a Dockerfile or a prebuilt image.
backup_missing: Could not verify the previous source. Preserve backups and review manual recovery.
source_changed: The checkout does not match the recorded commit. Sync again.
existingFolderTitle: An existing local folder was found
existingInstalled: This app is already installed in Home Assistant. It will be managed as an update.
existingNotInstalled: Local files exist, but Supervisor does not list the app as installed.
existingEmptyHelp: The folder is empty. The manager will reuse it to install this app.
existingFolderHelp: The folder contains an app with the same slug. A copy of its previous source will be kept during the operation. This is not a backup of its data or image.
adoptionConsent: I authorize the manager to adopt this folder and replace its source with the specified commit.
unsafe_local_folder: The local path is not a safe directory. It will not be modified.
local_manifest_mismatch: The existing folder does not contain exactly one app with the same slug. It will not be overwritten.
adoption_confirmation_required: Review the local folder and explicitly confirm adoption.
local_folder_changed: The local folder has changed since review. Review it and confirm again.
noReadme: This folder has no README. App documentation can be viewed separately when available.
documentation_unsafe: The document path or type is not allowed.
documentation_missing: The document does not exist or exceeds the size limit.
documentation_unreadable: Could not read the documentation as UTF-8 text.
documentation_image: The repository image is invalid or uses an unsupported format.
catalog_invalid: The repository.yaml metadata file is invalid.
removeAppText: Only this local source folder and its manager record will be deleted. If installed, you will be asked to authorize uninstalling it first. The remote repository and other apps are kept.
removeAppConsent: I confirm that I want to delete this local copy.
hideApp: Also hide this app from the manager catalog (you can show it again).
finishRemovalText: The manager will check that the app is still uninstalled and finish deleting the folder set aside for this deletion. Other apps are kept.
uninstallText: Supervisor will uninstall this app. Its local source is kept so you can install it again from this manager.
uninstallWarning: Home Assistant deletes the app’s internal data and options when uninstalling. This cannot be undone. The public app_config folder is kept unless you choose to delete it.
uninstallConsent: I authorize uninstalling this app and losing its internal data.
removeConfig: Also delete the public configuration folder (app_config).
uninstallRecoveryText: Check that no installation or uninstallation is running. Without retry enabled, the manager only checks the state: if the app is already uninstalled, the pending operation is completed.
retryUninstall: If still installed, I authorize retrying its uninstallation.
uninstallReviewed: I checked that no operation is running for this app.
removeConfigChosen: The original operation includes deleting public configuration.
keepConfigChosen: The original operation keeps public configuration.
uninstall_consent: Authorize uninstallation before deleting an installed app.
uninstall_uncertain: The app is still installed or uninstallation may still be running. Review recovery before retrying.
configurationHelp: Edit app options under options. You can also adjust boot (auto/manual), watchdog, network (ports), auto_update, ingress_panel and audio_input/audio_output when available. Supports !secret references. Supervisor validates on save; options apply at the next start. This editor may display credentials.
configurationRestart: Restart after saving if the app is running.
configurationValid: Preliminary check passed. Supervisor will validate all settings on save.
unsavedConfiguration: There are unsaved changes. Keep editing or choose Discard changes to close.
config_yaml: Check the YAML: use unique text keys, valid types and supported settings only. Cycles, automatic dates and excessively complex documents are not supported.
config_invalid: Options failed Supervisor schema or password checks. Review the schema and values.
config_changed: Configuration changed since you opened it. Keep your edits if needed and reopen it before saving.
config_restart_failed: Configuration saved, but restart could not be confirmed. Check app logs.
config_uncertain: Saving could not be confirmed. Reopen the configuration and check its values before repeating the operation.
app_logs_failed: Could not read app logs. Check the app state and try again.
configurationFormHelp: Form generated from this app’s Home Assistant schema, using its types, limits, choices and translations. YAML remains available as an advanced option. Supervisor validates before saving.
noDeclaredOptions: This app declares no editable options.
unsupportedFormValue: This value is preserved. Use Advanced YAML to edit this unsupported representation.
app_no_ingress: This app does not offer a web interface through Ingress.
app_not_running: Start the app before opening its web interface.
webInterfaceBusy: Wait for the operation to finish or resolve recovery before opening the interface.
ha_version_unavailable: Could not identify the Home Assistant version. Try again.
invalid_ingress_path: Could not verify this app’s Ingress path.
backupsHelp: Native Home Assistant backups containing this app, including general backups. Restoring recovers only this app.
emptyBackups: No accessible backups for this app.
backupPasswordHelp: Without a password the backup will not be encrypted. Keep the password somewhere safe: the manager does not retain or recover it.
createBackupHelp: App data and configuration will be saved to Home Assistant local backup storage. Supervisor may temporarily stop the app. The job continues if you close the manager.
restoreBackupHelp: This app’s data, configuration and installed version will be replaced with the backup. It may stop or restart. Home Assistant, other apps and shared folders will not be restored. Local Git source is retained; review the version before updating again.
restoreBackupConsent: I understand this app’s current data will be replaced.
backup_app_missing: This backup does not contain the app or is not accessible.
backup_uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. The operation may still be running. Refresh backups and check the app and Supervisor logs before retrying.
stage_backupCreating: Saving app backup in Home Assistant
backupWholeArchive: This operation affects the entire backup archive.
backupSharedWarning: This backup also contains other data or apps. The entire archive will be downloaded or deleted, not just this app’s part.
downloadBackupHelp: Download the original .tar archive, retaining password encryption when present. No password is needed to download. Your browser shows progress; if interrupted, download the whole archive again. Store it safely.
deleteBackupHelp: The entire backup will be deleted from these locations: {locations}. This cannot be undone. Installed apps and their current data are retained. Downloaded copies and Home Assistant Link will not be deleted.
deleteBackupConsent: I understand the entire backup will be deleted from the listed locations.
backup_changed: The backup changed. Refresh the list and review the operation again.
backup_download_failed: The backup could not be downloaded or the transfer was interrupted. Refresh the list and download the whole archive again.
backup_delete_uncertain: Deletion could not be confirmed. It may still be running or have been partial. Refresh backups and check Supervisor before retrying.
backupBeforeHelp: The pre-update backup is saved locally without encryption. If it fails, the update stops.
backupImportHelp: Select a Home Assistant backup up to 512 MiB. You can then review the version and decide whether to restore it.
backupImported: Backup imported. You can review the restore.
backup_import_invalid: Select a valid Home Assistant .tar backup.
backup_import_size: The backup exceeds the upload limit.
backup_import_space: There is not enough space for the temporary backup.
backup_import_uncertain: The import could not be confirmed. Refresh the list before trying again.
backup_import_duplicate: A backup with this ID already exists.
backupScheduleHelp: Use 0 hours to disable the schedule. Scheduled backups are stored locally without encryption. Retention only removes local copies created by this schedule.
yunohost_required: Open this app from the YunoHost portal.
yunohostScope: Sync private repositories and review their manifests and documentation. Installing and backing up add-ons requires Home Assistant Supervisor.
yunohostSecurity: The YunoHost portal controls access. Keys and tokens are kept in the app’s private data directory.
